Definition: of Latin origin; (in the genitive, i.e. possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman:--Appii.
BiblicalUsage: Appii Forum was a market town on the road to Rome, and the brothers came out from Rome to meet Paul there, as far as Appii Forum and the Three Taverns. When Paul saw them he thanked God and took courage.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sends encouragement on the road, and sometimes it looks like friends walking out to meet you a long way from home.
